{{Quote|No one ever gets to fire the baradium missiles.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Dark Nest I: The Joiner King">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>}}
A '''baradium missile''' was a type of [[Missile/Legends|missile]] used by the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] and other factions. One of their first recorded uses was in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], during the [[Mission to Myrkr]], where a baradium missile was fired into the hangar of [[Baanu Rass]]. In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], [[Lumiya]] used a [[Fusioncutter/Legends|fusion cutter]] on a baradium missile in the missile hold of the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']]. In [[44 ABY]], Baradium missiles were used during the [[Battle over Exodo II]] by the forces of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Drikl Lecersen]] to destroy the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Gilad Pellaeon (starship)|''Gilad Pellaeon'']] and the moon [[Boreleo]]. These missiles had a triggering mechanism that used a [[Deuterium/Legends|deuterium]]-based [[Proton grenade/Legends|proton charge]], which on its own was capable of producing a blast comparable to some thermal detonators.<ref name="Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref>
